row.notes: (self, car) where car[0] = vehicle index, car+0x28 lap state (int laps +0x20, frac +0x10, +0x140/+0x144 floats), car+0x38 resource data (+8 amount, +0xc factor, +0x10 reserve*5, +0x18/+0x1c/+0x20 three per-lap rates, +0x3c speed). If [car+0x28]+0x140 > 2.0 stores lap progress to self+0xc. Computes three budget ratios ratio_i = clamp(amount*factor - 5*reserve) / (self+0x10 * rate_i * (self+8 laps - progress)) into ...
